title: Rural Midwest Family, Snow Farmhouse Silo - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A quiet winter portrait depicting a rural American family standing before their modest stucco farmhouse amid snow-covered ground. The group features a father in a dark coat, a mother wrapped in a warm winter coat, and two young children in dark coveralls standing closely in front. In the background stands a tall farm silo and an auxiliary shed, while another figure bends down on the far right near the building's edge. The austere composition reflects early 20th-century rural life and resilience during the interwar Great Depression era.
